title: Show and edit all nine pictures used to make the farm's ground

first_action: In hq/data/entities.json, terrain_field and terrain_floor declare frames [[0,0,48,48]] but the game draws only the centre 16x16 cell. Give a seamless ground sheet a frame definition of that one cell, and write the edited cell back into all nine copies on save, so what he paints is what ships.
source_message: Landed without Daniel: “Read Daniel's hand edit to Field Grassland”.
result: The sprite editor now shows all nine cells of each ground sheet and previews how the farm repeats them. A save writes only cells the player edited. This matches the current renderer, which chooses a cell by tile position; copying one cell over all nine would erase the field’s variation. The earlier card result described that obsolete copy-all behavior and remains in its history.

The broader HQ JavaScript run still has an unrelated queue-state assertion failure, and pytest is not installed in this worktree.

findings.what: The new comment contradicts the known behavior: the game draws only the center cell, not all nine positions.
findings.fix: Say the sheet stores nine copies while the game samples the center cell, explaining that replication prevents those copies from drifting.
